captions: 4:40 p.m. Treadmill four. Same spot as always.
32 minutes. Your lungs burn. You keep going.
Your watch buzzes: Maghrib. You almost swipe it away.
The man beside you steps off. Unrolls a small mat.
5:41 a.m. Your legs still ache. You walk anyway.
Day one of a new streak. The one that counts.

post.caption:
41 days without missing the gym. Fajr? 2 out of 7. 🤍

You already have the discipline. Give it to the One who gave you the body.

“Indeed, Allah loves those who are constantly repentant.” (2:222)

Tonight, set one alarm. For Fajr. Day one starts tomorrow.
